tools.name: archive_and_report_camera_clip
tools.description: Moves a recorded security camera clip from the live recordings folder into the archive folder and posts the clip details to the home monitoring service's webhook.

params.name: clip_name
params.description: File name of the camera clip in the recordings folder

params.name: camera_id
params.description: Identifier of the camera that recorded the clip

tools.code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

import requests

RECORDINGS_DIR = Path("/var/smarthome/recordings")
ARCHIVE_DIR = Path("/var/smarthome/archive")
WEBHOOK_URL = "https://monitor.home.local/api/webhooks/clip-archived"


def _notify(camera_id, dest):
    payload = {"camera_id": camera_id, "archived_path": str(dest), "size": dest.stat().st_size}
    resp = requests.post(WEBHOOK_URL, json=payload, timeout=10)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.status_code


def archive_and_report_camera_clip(clip_name: str, camera_id: str) -> dict:
    src = RECORDINGS_DIR / Path(clip_name).name
    if not src.exists():
        return {"ok": False, "error": "clip not found"}
    target_dir = ARCHIVE_DIR / camera_id
    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest = target_dir / src.name
    shutil.move(str(src), str(dest))
    status = _notify(camera_id, dest)
    return {"ok": True, "archived_to": str(dest), "webhook_status": status}
